applicabilityBasis.summary: AUDX is an issuer-managed 1:1 Australian-dollar token with stated redemption and payment/trading uses; that is a payment-stablecoin profile even though its issuer is Australian.

genius.issuerEntity: TAU Pty Ltd (ACN 649 232 995), trading as AUDX Token
genius.notes: Review as of 2026-10-07: issuerEntity is preserved verbatim and supported by the TAU token-sale terms. Direct AUD1 redemption requires whitelisting and at least 100,000 tokens and carries the terms' 1% redemption fee. No issuer-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, pending application or foreign registration was found. The public monthly reserve series extends through August 2026; Aura Partners report signed 22 September provides limited assurance on reserves and token supply, rather than a full audit. The failed generic AUSTRAC VASP notice was removed without inferring a current issuer registration. Kraken EU restrictions are evaluated separately under MiCA and do not establish GENIUS enforcement. Broad GENIUS DASP restrictions remain prospective.
